deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] runtime-pin: runtime-3.2 CANARY pinned due to kvcache mismatch; blocking unpin until 2025-04-12T16:00:00Z (change window 15:30-16:30). Reason: "kv-cache misindex -> response corruption on longseq". @jamie please ack if override needed. :warning:  

jamie: acked. seeing uplift in longseq error rate (~3%) and token lat 95p +0.4s over baseline. I'm inclined to keep pinned for now. Can we get more context on repro?  

ella: repro in eu-west: model=llama3q, seq=8192 triggers `kv_cache` OOB when kernel=optimized-kv (3.2). Stack: `kv_get -> index_calc -> OOB`. We have a small guard patch (bounds-check) but it needs a full pass of QA. PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/789  

matt: client teams pushing for unpin due to throughput concerns in Hosted API (some critical customers). Is soft-fallback routing possible as mitigation?  

sophie: we can implement a gradual fallback: route 10% of canary traffic to runtime-3.1 legacy kernel with header `x-runtime-fallback: legacy` and observe errors. If stable, escalate to 30%. This avoids global unpin. We'll need routing flag `canary_fallback=on` and a short runbook for monitoring.  

jamie: +1 to fallback. Also propose adding a telemetry guard: if error_rate_longseq > 1.5% for 5m -> automatic rollback to legacy route. Add note in release docs.  

matt: can we add a short runbook snippet here?  

ella: runbook snippet:
```
# fallback runbook (canary)
1. enable flag: `canary_fallback=on`
2. route 10% -> runtime-3.1
3. monitor `errors.longseq` and `p50/p95 latency` for 10m
4. if errors.longseq > 1.5% -> increase to 50% and notify #eng-oncall
5. if errors.longseq > 5% -> rollback to pinned state and open incident
```  

jamie: saved. I'll add to the release notes draft: "Canary runtime-3.2 pinned due to kv-cache regression; fallback routing enabled while guards/QAs run. Patch PR#789 scheduled for post-window hotfix if QA passes."  

matt: noted. I'll hold the unpin action in deploybot until 16:30 UTC. If QA approves earlier, we can re-evaluate.  

sophie: I'll create the routing flag and a short dashboard (per-route errors + longseq sample logs). ETA 45m.  

deploybot: noted - will suppress auto-unpin and add a manual hold tag `hold-by-eng-releases` until 2025-04-12T16:30:00Z. To override: `@deploybot override hold-by-eng-releases` from an eng-release approver. :white_check_mark:  

ella: one more note — collect a few failing traces from eu-west (seq>4096) and attach to PR. Example log snippet:
```
[2025-04-12T15:02:11Z] runtime-canary-3 kv_get idx=2147483650 -> index_calc -> panic: index out of range
model=llama3q seq=8192 request_id=abc123
```  

jamie: thanks. tagging QA: @sophie please coordinate with QA for a quick smoke test when patch lands.  

sophie: will do. I'll post back here with dashboard link once ready. :rocket:
